title: Writing and balancing simple chemical equation
competency: Write a chemical equation from a word equation.

keywords.def: A shorthand expression of a chemical reaction through symbols and formulas.

en.text: A chemical equation shows a reaction with symbols and formulas. Step 1: write a word equation. Step 2: write the formula of each reactant and product. Step 3: balance it. Hydrogen + oxygen → water becomes H₂ + O₂ → H₂O, then 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O.

screens.title: Short hand
screens.ask: Which is shorter to write: "hydrogen and oxygen produce water" or "2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O"?
screens.after:
"2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O" is much shorter than the words.
Chemists write reactions with symbols and formulas.
This is a chemical equation.

screens.title: 3.3.5 Writing a chemical equation
paras: A chemical equation is a short hand of a chemical reaction.

screens.title: From words to formulas
screens.ask: Tap each word to see its symbol or formula.
items: H₂. Hydrogen gas is diatomic: two atoms joined.
O₂. Oxygen gas is diatomic too.
H₂O: two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
Mg. A metal is written with its symbol only.
MgO. Valences 2 and 2 give Mg₂O₂, which simplifies to MgO.

screens.title: Example: making water
steps: Step 1, word equation: hydrogen + oxygen → water.
Step 2, formulas: H₂ + O₂ → H₂O. (Hydrogen and oxygen are diatomic.)
Count O: 2 on the left, 1 on the right. Put 2 before H₂O.
Now H: 4 on the right. Put 2 before H₂.

screens.title: Example: burning magnesium
steps: Step 1, word equation: magnesium + oxygen → magnesium oxide.
Count O: 2 on the left, 1 on the right. Put 2 before MgO.
Now Mg: 2 on the right. Put 2 before Mg.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A shorthand expression of a chemical reaction through symbols and formulas.

screens.text: Writing equations: what is the first step in writing a chemical equation?
screens.why:
We go from words to symbols.
Step 1 is the word equation.
Step 2 is the formulas. Step 3 is balancing.
So the first step is to write a word equation.
Balancing comes last, after the formulas.

screens.title: Put the steps in order
items: Write the formula of each substance
screens.why:
Step 1: write the word equation.
Step 2: write the formula of each substance.
Step 3: balance the equation.
You cannot balance before you have formulas.
screens.text: Put the three steps for writing a chemical equation in order.
Step 2, formulas: hydrogen + oxygen → water. Which line has the correct formulas (before balancing)?
screens.why:
Hydrogen and oxygen are diatomic gases.
So hydrogen is H₂ and oxygen is O₂.
Water is H₂O.
So the line is H₂ + O₂ → H₂O.
"H + O" forgets that the gases are diatomic.

screens.text: Balancing: why does 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O have a 2 before H₂O?
opts: To make 2 oxygen atoms on the right
screens.ans: To make 2 oxygen atoms on the right
screens.why:
Count O on the left: O₂ gives 2 oxygen atoms.
H₂O has only 1 O, so the right needs 2H₂O.
2H₂O gives 2 oxygen atoms on the right.
Coefficients count molecules. They do not change water.
H₄O₂ would be a different formula, which is not allowed.
screens.clue: Count the oxygen atoms on each side.

test.text: What does a chemical equation use to show a reaction?
test.why:
A chemical equation is a short hand of a reaction.
It uses symbols for elements and formulas for compounds.
A word equation uses only words.
So the answer is symbols and formulas.

Step 1: word equation.
Step 2: formulas.
Step 3: balance the equation.

test.text: Formulas: how is oxygen gas written?
test.why:
Oxygen gas is diatomic.
Two oxygen atoms join in one molecule.
So oxygen gas is written O₂.
O is one atom; O₃ is ozone, not oxygen gas.

test.text: Choose the balanced equation for hydrogen + oxygen → water.
test.why:
Start with H₂ + O₂ → H₂O.
O: 2 on the left, 1 on the right. Put 2 before H₂O.
H: now 4 on the right. Put 2 before H₂.
2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O.
Check: H 4 = 4, O 2 = 2.

test.text: Step 2, formulas: magnesium + oxygen → magnesium oxide. Which formulas are right?
test.why:
Magnesium is a metal: Mg.
Oxygen gas is diatomic: O₂.
Magnesium oxide: valences 2 and 2 give Mg₂O₂, which simplifies to MgO.
So the formulas are Mg + O₂ → MgO.
Mg₂ and MgO₂ are wrong formulas.
